h1: The worksheet you need, ready in about a minute
lead: {makers} worksheet makers for kindergarten to grade 3, from counting to cursive. Pick a worksheet, change the level, the pictures and the language, then print it or send it to a screen.
line: {makers} makers. {templates} worksheets. Thousands of pictures. {languages} languages. One simple screen.
searchLabel: What are you teaching this week?
noResults: Nothing matches that. Try a shorter word.
group_numbers_blurb: From the first count to place value.
group_operations_blurb: Addition, times tables, fractions and word problems.
group_measure_blurb: The math children use every day.
group_shapes_blurb: Geometry, maps, symmetry and repeating patterns.
group_reading_blurb: From first sounds to reading a whole story.
group_words_blurb: Spelling, vocabulary, grammar and writing stories.
group_writing_blurb: From first pencil lines to joined writing.
group_thinking_blurb: Logic, mazes, word puzzles and classroom games.
group_me_blurb: Quiet pages, and pages about feelings and family.
step1Body: Find it by topic, grade or word. Every worksheet shows a real sample before you open it.
langTitle: One worksheet, every language you teach
langBody: The same worksheet comes out in your language, with its own words, grade names and school conventions. Each version was written in that language, so multilingual classes can use the same page side by side.
picTitle: A picture for everything you teach
picBody: Thousands of reviewed pictures, sorted into themes, in color or black and white. Change the theme and the whole page changes with it. Click any single picture to swap it.
twoTitle: Print it, play it or share it
twoPaperBody: A clean PDF with its answer key, on US Letter or A4, ready for the copier.
twoScreenBody: Most worksheets also open as interactive pages. Children tap, drag or type and see right away if they are right.
twoShareBody: With the Teacher plan you keep your worksheets, come back to change them and share them by link or QR code. Children need no account.
classicTitle: Looking for a classic worksheet maker page?
